prompt.description: Question or wait prompt for the user

choices.description: Optional multi-choice options; omit or empty for free text

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before wait_timeout wake (default 300; free-text also defaults 300). Prefer longer for open-ended human replies.

conversation_id.description: Social address dm:<user> or group:<id>. Same resolution as speak; group waits require session bound to the room.

user_id.description: Arming / notify stamp (defaults to active wake user). Group match uses membership + session conversation, not this alone.
